content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The recruitment is for full-time contractual positions at DD India, Doordarshan Bhawan, New Delhi. The official NIA carries reference NIA/2026/08/DDN and is dated 28 July 2026. Register for Job Alerts

rows.details: DD India, Doordarshan Bhawan, New Delhi
Graduate + Professional Diploma in Film and Video Editing

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 7 positions have been notified under Prasar Bharati Video Editor Recruitment 2026. The notification also states that Prasar Bharati reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions depending on organizational requirements.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Prasar Bharati Video Editor posts must satisfy the prescribed educational qualification, experience and age requirements. The recruitment is open to Indian nationals only, and candidates should verify that they meet all requirements before submitting the online application. Applicants must have: A Graduate degree from any recognized University/Institute. A Professional Diploma in Film and Video Editing. Proficiency in the English language. These requirements are listed in the official notice for the Video Post Production Assistant/Video Editor engagement. Candidates must possess at least 3 years of experience in the relevant field. The notification further states that age, experience and education will be considered up to the date of issue of the NIA, inclusive.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Age Limit
content_sections.text: The prescribed age requirement is: Below 45 years as on the date of notification. Candidates should check their age with reference to the notification date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates can receive negotiable consolidated monthly remuneration up to ₹50,000. The position is contractual and does not create a claim for absorption or regularization in Prasar Bharati. No pensionary benefit is admissible on account of this contractual engagement.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee for this engagement. Candidates should rely on the official application portal and recruitment notice for applicable instructions rather than assuming that a fee is required.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice does not provide a fixed calendar last date. Instead, it requires applications to be submitted within 15 days from the date of publication of the NIA on the Prasar Bharati website. Important: The NIA date should not automatically be treated as the online publication date. Candidates should check the publication/application portal to determine the exact deadline.

rows.date: Within 15 days from publication of the NIA on the Prasar Bharati website

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Prasar Bharati reserves the right to conduct a test and/or interview of shortlisted candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted through email. The notice also states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the test or interview. Selection Process: Shortlisting → Test and/or Interview → Final Engagement

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Nature of Duties
content_sections.text: The selected Video Post Production Assistant/Video Editor will primarily be responsible for video editing and production of television programmes, along with any other work assigned by the Supervisory Officer. Candidates engaged under the contract may also be assigned additional tasks beyond the specific work for which they were engaged.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Contract Period
content_sections.text: The initial engagement period is one year. The notification states that there will be an annual appraisal and the engagement may be renewed depending on organizational requirements and performance review. The engagement may also be discontinued or terminated by either side with one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu thereof, without assigning any reason. The engagement is full-time, and an engaged person will not be permitted to take up another assignment during the contractual period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Prasar Bharati Video Editor Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit the Prasar Bharati Video Editor Apply Online application through the Prasar Bharati application portal. Read the official notification carefully. Check the qualification, experience and age eligibility. Open the Prasar Bharati online application portal. Fill in the required application details. Upload complete and clear copies of all requested documents. Review the application before final submission. Submit the application within the prescribed deadline. Save the submitted application details for future reference. Applications submitted through any mode other than the Prasar Bharati online application portal will not be considered. The notification also states that candidature may be rejected without intimation if candidates fail to upload complete and clear copies of the requested documents.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Video Editor Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the qualification, experience, age and other requirements can apply online through the official application portal. The application should be submitted within 15 days from publication of the NIA on the Prasar Bharati website.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Keep Ready
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep relevant educational, professional and experience documents ready while completing the online application. The official notice specifically asks applicants to upload complete and clear copies of all requested documents. Failure to do so may result in rejection of candidature.
